scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const nodeModulesPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules');if(!fs.existsSync(nodeModulesPath)){console.log('[predev] 检测到未安装依赖，正在执行 npm install...');process.exit(1);}" || npm install
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const distPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist');if(fs.existsSync(distPath)){fs.rmSync(distPath,{recursive:true});console.log('[clean] 已清理 dist 目录');}"
